name: Flask
description: Lightweight project-level Python web framework installed into a virtual environment.
longDescription: Flask is a micro web framework for Python. It is installed inside each project's virtual environment rather than globally. DevForge treats it as a project recipe and ensures Python is available before you start.
caveats: Flask is installed per project inside a virtual environment, not globally.

dependencies.reason: Flask runs on Python and is installed into a project virtual environment.

projectRecipe.summary: Create an isolated Python environment and install Flask for this project.

commands.label: Create and activate a virtual environment
Run a minimal application
commands.command: python -c "from flask import Flask; app=Flask(__name__); app.run()"

notes: Run these commands inside your own project folder.
